title: CBSE chapter file
description: One chapter page at /cbse/class-{class}/{subject}/{slug}. Save as Data/Seed/cbse/class-{class}/{subject}/{number, two digits}-{slug}.json, e.g. class-6/mathematics/01-<slug>.json. The site reloads changed files in Development and on restart in production. Invalid files are skipped and the reason is written to the log.

class.description: Only Class 6 is offered for now.

number.description: Chapter number in the textbook. Sets the order and Previous / Next links.

slug.description: The last part of the URL, from the chapter name.

title.description: The chapter name exactly as in the textbook.

book.description: The textbook, if the chapter follows one, e.g. "Ganita Prakash (NCERT)". Leave out for Personality Development.

summary.description: 1–2 sentences. Used as the page intro and the meta description (keep under 155 characters).

updated.description: Date the content last changed (yyyy-MM-dd): the sitemap lastmod.

notes.description: Concept notes in Markdown: ## headings, lists, | tables |, **bold**. Raw HTML is ignored. Mark unsure facts with [VERIFY].

notesHi.description: The same notes in Hindi (Markdown). Optional.

questions.description: Practice questions: the brief asks for 10, of which 3 are case-based.

kind.description: "case" = case-based / competency question: give the situation in "case".

case.description: Required when kind is "case": the short real-life situation to read first.

answer.description: Index of the right option (0 = A).
